name: Phenoperidine
summary: Phenoperidine (Operidine or Lealgin), is an opioid analgesic which is structurally related to pethidine and is used clinically as a general anesthetic.

pharmacology.text: It is a derivative of isonipecotic acid, like pethidine, and is metabolized in part to norpethidine. Its potency range is due to method of ingestion. figure 20–80 times as potent as pethidine as an analgesic. The greatly increased potency essentially eliminates the toxic effects of norpethidine accumulation which are seen when pethidine is administered in high doses or for long periods of time.

uses.text: Phenoperidine (Operidine or Lealgin), is an opioid analgesic which is structurally related to pethidine and is used clinically as a general anesthetic.

sideEffects.en: Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. Because part of it becomes pethidine, the toxic metabolite norpethidine can build up with repeated use.
sideEffects.zh: 它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。由於它有一部分會轉變成配西汀，反覆使用時有毒的代謝物去甲哌替啶可能累積。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。由于它有一部分会转变成配西汀，反复使用时有毒的代谢物去甲哌替啶可能累积。

fact.en: It was used in anaesthesia, especially in France and Britain, and the body turns part of it into pethidine.
fact.zh: 它曾用於麻醉，尤其在法國與英國。人體會把它的一部分轉變成配西汀。
fact.zhHans: 它曾用于麻醉，尤其在法国与英国。人体会把它的一部分转变成配西汀。
